title: NCAAB tab update (app v1.0.148): games with no betting odds at all (no Novig market and no ESPN line, which is what the small schools' games look like) are no longer listed in any of its pages (Games, Leans, Unlike averages). The footnote at the bottom says how many were left out, e.g. '60 games with no betting odds (small schools) are not listed'. One safeguard: until Novig's lines have been read at least once the tab hides nothing, so a late board never leaves you with an empty schedule.
